description: This file implements utility functions for handling URL request redirects, including updating HTTP request headers during redirects, extracting referrer policies, and synthesizing redirect response headers.

methods.name: UpdateHttpRequest
methods.description: Updates HTTP request headers during a redirect, handling header removal, method change, and origin header adjustments for cross-origin requests.

methods.name: GetReferrerPolicyHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the 'Referrer-Policy' header from HTTP response headers if present.

methods.name: SynthesizeRedirectHeaders
methods.description: Creates a synthetic HTTP response headers object representing a redirect response, including CORS headers if applicable.
